verdict.rationale: GrowthBook explicitly lets teams define Fact Tables and metrics computed directly from their own warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) rather than relying on a proprietary metric store, and independent community commentary confirms this warehouse-native design as a key differentiator from black-box tools like Optimizely. missing for 10: hands-on PM-level walkthrough of defining a metric from ingested event data (vs. warehouse tables) and any independent report specifically validating metric-definition UX.
